targets.gloss: We live in Canada (the 'enga irukkeenga?' answer)
I don't know anything (staying out of it — comedy gold fired deadpan)

turns.text: Athai tugs your sleeve, eyes gleaming: "Andrew, kelu da — Karthi's friend's akka, appadiye Canada-ku poyi settle aayidunga!" She waits, grinning, for your reaction.
Athai waves that off — "province therla, aana kanadaavula irukkom-nu sonnanga" — just "we live in Canada," that's all she caught.

turns.recast: Canada-la irukkom — "we live in Canada." Iruppom is "we will live" (future); irukkom is the one for right now.

slips.note: future tense (will live) used where present-habitual (live) was needed for the target phrase

turns.text: Athai grins — "arukil, aana iruppom-nu sollama irukkom, da — 'Canada-la irukkom'!" Already she's onto the akka's husband's new job.
not sure what she's asking me or what to reply?
She's not asking you anything, da — just gossiping. "Nalla job-am sollranga... aana yaarukku theriyum," she shrugs — who even knows if it's true.
Athai nods, grinning — "ama, software job dhaan-nu sonnanga, aana yaarukku theriyum, correct-ah irukkuma!" Already eyeing the next house's gossip.
Just shrug like her, da — "yaarukku theriyum," who knows. Try it?
adhu dhaan — yaarukku theriyum! Full Athai shrug, da, she's impressed.

brief.wants: Athai has news about someone in the house and wants his reaction

beat: Athai gossiped about Karthi's friend's akka settling in Canada with a software job, and Andrew landed the "who knows" shrug after a hint.
